prompt: need the UStVA Q3 2026 for my UG done, everything is in this folder (invoices/, bank + stripe csv, my notes). put the Kennzahlen in out/ustva.json like {"kz81": 123, ...} (only the Kz that are not empty, euro amounts as numbers) and a short out/notes.md with what you did and anything I need to decide. also the finanzamt letter in post/ - until when exactly can I still file an Einspruch against it? dont submit anything, I type it into elster myself.
rubric: A founder self-files the Q3 2026 Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung of a small UG (Ist-Versteuerung, Regelbesteuerung, no USt-IdNr) and asks for the Einspruch deadline against an estimated Q2 assessment dated 29.09.2026. Better run: revenue Kz 81 = 500 (595 gross incl. 19 %, founder's refunded test charge excluded); Anthropic Ireland invoice with customer VAT ID DE000000000 and 'VAT Germany 19 %' treated as EU reverse charge on the net (Kz 46 = 100, Kz 47 = 19.00) and its invoiced 19 % NOT claimed as Vorsteuer; Cursor (US, also DE000000000) and Supabase (Singapore, USD 25 at the BMF monthly rate) as third-country reverse charge Kz 84/85; Kz 67 equals the reverse-charge tax; Kz 66 = 5.70 only from the German Hetzner invoice; the IONOS domain invoice addressed to the founder privately gives no Vorsteuer (expense via Auslagenersatz/Eigenbeleg instead); Einspruch deadline 05.11.2026 from the 4-day Bekanntgabe rule (fourth day 03.10. is a Saturday and holiday, so Monday 05.10.) and not the 02.11. payment due date; recommends getting a USt-IdNr and filing the missing Q2 return (it replaces the estimate) and/or Einspruch with AdV. Penalize claiming the DE000000000 VAT or private-invoice VAT as Vorsteuer, mixing EU and third-country lines, 3-day Bekanntgabe, confusing due date with Einspruch deadline, and any claim of having submitted.
